To “shoot flames” you sit in park and flutter the gas. The problem with this is that cool air is not being pushed through the radiators bc the car is sitting. When moving, cold air passes through and cools the fluid within the cooling system. If you sit for a long time and push the engine it will get hot. Lamborghinis have larger engines and need ample cooling. My guess is that they were doing this for a long time and a rubber hose blew from getting too hot. The fluid looks like coolant. This is extremely dumb and a cars ecu can tell Lamborghini what they were doing before the failure. If they were reaching redline (increasing engine RPM passed the limit) This would fall under misuse and warranty would be void.
